stem.text: A molecule of geraniol is shown.

stem.label: geraniol
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of geraniol: (CH3)2C=CH-CH2-CH2-C(CH3)=CH-CH2OH, with the name geraniol printed above.

stem.text: What is formed when geraniol is reacted with an excess of cold dilute acidified $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a polyhydroxy chain with four OH groups (two on tertiary carbons, two on secondary carbons) and a terminal CH2OH.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a chain with two ketone C=O groups, two tertiary OH groups and a terminal COOH.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of hydroxyethanoic acid: HOCH2COOH.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a dimethylocta-dienoic acid (geranic acid type): C=C bonds in the chain and a terminal COOH.
